integrity: The proof is a direct implication of the universal identity vertex and the published diameter-two obstruction, with the small orders handled explicitly. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for the full enhanced power graph; deleting the identity or other dominating vertices invalidates the diameter-two argument.
Originality was checked against the named primary sources, targeted literature searches, and a mathematical-results database, but unindexed sources remain a residual risk.
title: Multiset dimension of every finite enhanced power graph
